text: Ko Ibraahiima ɗaɓɓirannoo ben mun kon yaafuyee wonaa si wanaa fii ko fodoore nde o fodondirnoo e makko, jortagol yo o silmu. Nde ɓanngannoo Ibraahiima wonnde ben makko ko gaño Alla, tawde laaɓal reedu nafataa mo, maa hara o anndirii wahayu on wonnde on maayiday e keeferaaku, o hisnii e mum, insinangol mo ngol ko e makko tun iwrunoo, ɗum wanaa lunndagol ñaawoore Alla wahayinaande e makko. Pellet, Ibraahiima (yo o his), ko ɗuuɗuɗo yankinanagol Alla, ɗuuɗuɗo laaɓal reedu e yawtangol yimɓe makko tooñooɓe ɓen.
